scope.statement: Repository-local instructions for implementation, verification, release, and documentation work.

sourceOfTruth.statement: Executable implementation and migrations define current behavior.
Passing behavior-level tests are evidence; test existence alone is not.
Declared commands and runtime topology must match these files.
Documentation explains verified implementation and must not overrule it.

rules.statement: Inspect the nearest route, service, domain rule, migration, configuration, and test before changing behavior.
Make the smallest scoped change, preserve unrelated worktree changes, and avoid new dependencies unless necessary.
State-changing workflow/operator actions require principal-derived or bounded system audit identity.
Describe the queue as at-least-once, never exactly-once, and make new effects replay-safe.
Normal tests use deterministic mock providers and do not require credentials or live network access.
Visible UI behavior requires browser interaction evidence; components or screenshots alone are insufficient.
Applied migrations are immutable and forward-only; recovery is matching snapshot restore or a new forward fix.
Do not mark completion from status fields, paths, counts, or declarations when behavior-level evidence is missing.

securityInvariants.statement: Production requires authenticated durable sessions, secure cookies, no demo bypass, and a 32-character-or-longer session secret.
Minimal operator authentication is not role authorization or tenant isolation; never document v0.2 as public multi-tenant.
Unsafe browser/API mutations require same-origin, CSRF, and a stable idempotency key; HTTP input cannot choose system actor type.
Every fetch redirect and DNS result remains subject to public-address, byte, time, and media-type policy.
Uploads stay quarantined until a clean scan; production scanner error is fail-closed and mock/bypass is not production evidence.
Object keys and local paths remain contained, reads/writes are bounded, and relevant bytes are size/hash verified.
Fetched, uploaded, and model-produced content is untrusted; prompt-injection flags are review signals, not proof of safety.
Only RESOLVED clears a blocker; ACCEPTED_RISK cannot bypass blocker-gated approval or delivery.
Never add real credentials, customer data, private URLs, provider responses, or generated delivery artifacts to fixtures/source control.

completionEvidence.statement: Run the narrow test lane that directly exercises the requested behavior.
Run typecheck, lint, and build when the changed surface can affect them.
Run Playwright for UI navigation, state, persistence, mobile, accessibility-control, or auth behavior.
Parse and inspect generated PDF, DOCX, CSV, or ZIP outputs when export behavior changes.
Run strict management/link/path validation after documentation or metadata changes.
Report commands actually run, exact failures/skips, unverified boundaries, and relevant risks.

commands.purpose: Validate management JSON, declared repository references, and local Markdown links.
Run lint, typecheck, full Vitest, and build; Playwright remains separate.
